title: Vehicle acquired
details: Purchased 2009 BMW X5 E70 xDrive35d, VIN WBAFF01070L319611, for 12,000 DKK with known engine failure (crankshaft/connecting rod bearing damage).

title: Initial diagnostic scan
details: Confirmed engine mechanical failure. Recommend full teardown before committing to a rebuild-vs-replace decision. Replacement engine swap selected as project path.

title: Project OS set up
details: JARVIS X5 GARAGE OS deployed as the single source of truth for parts, tools, budget, timeline, and documentation.
